text:
alexa: anyone else see weird double-redaction in the onboarding sample? we're seeing `[REDACTED]` and then later `[REDACTED]` again in logs (makes debugging noisy)

tom: which sample + SDK? go-starter on 2.1.0?

alexa: go-starter, latest main. also request_id is missing on the first few logs (shows `request_id=undefined`) when OTEL_LOG_INJECTION=true

nina: raw line: `2026-04-02T14:03:21Z INFO http.request path=/chat request_id=undefined user_email=[REDACTED]`

lee: oof. looks like two problems: 1) reqid hook not wired before first log, so nil cast -> "undefined", 2) redaction regex runs in both our logger middleware and OTEL exporter and the second replace operates on already-replaced token ( regexp uses global replace with capture groups )

tom: for the reqid: we should avoid panic/cast and use safe lookup: `rid, _ := ctx.Value(reqIDKey).(string); if rid=="" { rid="-" }` and ensure logger.Init blocks until hooks registered or add retries

nina: for redaction: the sample sets REDWOOD_REDACT_PATTERNS="(api_key|token)" and OTEL also has its own redaction list; when both run, our replace does `s/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,})/[REDACTED]/g` which will turn `[REDACTED]` into `[REDACTED]` again? thinking it's an idempotency bug when pattern is too loose

alexa: can we make redaction idempotent? e.g. skip replacements if value already equals `[REDACTED]` or anchor patterns to avoid matching the bracketed string

lee: yes, change replace to `if strings.Contains(val, "[REDACTED]") { return val }` or compile regex with negative lookbehind to avoid matching `[REDACTED]`. both fine. also add tests for repeated redact passes.

tom: add a CI smoke test in examples/ that starts the sample with OTEL env toggled and greps logs for `request_id=undefined` or duplicate `[REDACTED]` occurrences; fail if found

nina: created a tiny repro script and attached to PR draft. will push patch to make reqid default to `init` and guard redactor. also updating README troubleshooting section to mention OTEL order caveat

dev-telemetry-bot: NOTE: created issue #4298 (devex) "onboard sample: early logs missing reqid + non-idempotent redactor" by nina

alexa: thanks! tagging eng-runtime for awareness, might affect startup metrics

lee: FYI i'll add a small unit test in our redaction package that simulates double-pass redaction and asserts no change after first pass

tom: small follow-up: consider exposing a sample env `EXPERIMENTAL_DELAY_LOG_INIT=true` to force deterministic init order during CI so we catch this earlier

alexa: love that. ok team, PRs incoming. will follow up if CI flags anything :pray:
